name: nexora
description: Nexora monorepo — TS, .NET and Python workspaces orchestrated by Turborepo

scripts.lint: turbo run lint && pnpm run lint:root
scripts.stack:up: node scripts/dev-env.mjs && docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env up -d --wait --wait-timeout 600 && docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile seed run --rm seed && docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile seed run --rm seed-s3 && docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile tools run --rm --build liquibase update && node scripts/dev-check.mjs
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile tools run --rm --build liquibase update
scripts.db:status: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile tools run --rm --build liquibase status
scripts.db:rollback-test: docker compose -f infra/compose/compose.yaml --env-file infra/compose/.env --profile tools run --rm --build liquibase rollback-test
